commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Alen Sherri pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+2' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
90+1' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' 3 - 3 Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) meets a perfect cross from Tommaso Augello deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the top right corner. It's 3:3.
87' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alen Sherri, who smothers the ball.
85' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
84' Wonderful movement by AC Milan. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

81' Substitution. Emerson Royal will be replaced by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan).
80' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

80' Cagliari are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner.
79' Cagliari take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' Antoine Makoumbou will be replaced by Razvan Marin (Cagliari).

74' Substitution. Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) replaces Jose Luis Palomino.
73' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) replaces Nicolas Viola.

67' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
67' Cagliari are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee signals a corner kick to Cagliari.
66' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Francesco Camarda is replaced by Tammy Abraham (AC Milan).

63' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

63' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Cagliari force their opponents to concede a corner.
62' A yellow card for a tackle by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan). Michael Fabbri doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
61' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
59' Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' Alen Sherri makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) after a cross from the side.
56' The current number of shots on goal is 6:2.
53' 2 - 2 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 2:2.

51' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
51' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan earn a free kick.
49' Cagliari showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.

46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Flag goes up against Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45+5' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Cagliari due to an offside in the build-up play.
45+3' Celebrations by Cagliari are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.

45+2' It's a goal! Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Tommaso Augello. The score is now 2:2.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

40' 1 - 2 Youssouf Fofana passes to Rafael Leao (AC Milan), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
39' A brilliant cross into the box finds Nadir Zortea (Cagliari), who directs his header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
38' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
37' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alen Sherri is well positioned and punches the ball away.
37' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort. AC Milan earn a corner.
36' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
35' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

30' Cagliari slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

26' Cagliari showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will take a throw-in.
23' AC Milan showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.

22' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. AC Milan are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
19' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is adjudged offside.
18' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
17' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

17' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
15' 1 - 1 GOAL - 1:1! Tijjani Reijnders found Rafael Leao (AC Milan) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Alen Sherri off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
15' AC Milan are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
13' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
12' AC Milan are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. AC Milan have a corner.
12' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

10' A clever short pass gives Rafael Leao (AC Milan) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
8' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

7' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
6' A cross from Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
5' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
4' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
2' 1 - 0 The ball from the corner slips through the box to Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) and he fires it into the bottom left corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
2' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner.

1' Cagliari show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.
